---
title: "Concepts"
---

Concept Objects define terminology, intuition, formal meaning, adjacent concepts, non-implications, and relevance to LDG. The sections below provide a public reading order through the current concept library.

## Foundational dynamics

- [State](state.qmd) — what information counts as the state of a specified system at a time. *(L1, stable)*
- [State Space](state-space.qmd) — the admissible state values under a specified state description. *(L1, stable)*
- [Trajectory](trajectory.qmd) — one admissible system evolution parameterized by system time. *(L1, stable)*
- [Phase Space](phase-space.qmd) — a state space read as the arena of dynamical trajectories. *(L2, stable)*
- [Initial Condition](initial-condition.qmd) — a state value assigned at a reference time. *(L1, stable)*
- [Vector Field](vector-field.qmd) — a local instantaneous state-change rule. *(L2, stable)*
- [Flow](flow.qmd) — finite-time evolution across supported initial states. *(L2, stable)*
- [Fixed Point](fixed-point.qmd) — a state unchanged by the specified evolution. *(L2, stable)*
- [Stability](stability.qmd) — response of a declared dynamical object to specified perturbations. *(L2, stable)*
- [Attractor](attractor.qmd) — an invariant set approached from a surrounding basin. *(L2, stable)*
- [Limit Cycle](limit-cycle.qmd) — an isolated periodic orbit with separately stated stability. *(L2, stable)*
- [Input-Driven Dynamics](input-driven-dynamics.qmd) — evolution depending on state and an external input signal. *(L2, stable)*

## Latent-variable foundations

- [Latent Variable](latent-variable.qmd) — a model variable not directly observed in the available data. *(L1, stable)*
- [Observation Model](observation-model.qmd) — the relation from latent or system variables to measurements. *(L2, stable)*
- [State-Space Model](state-space-model.qmd) — a joint transition and observation description. *(L2, stable)*
- [Linear Dynamical System](linear-dynamical-system.qmd) — linear state evolution with optional inputs and outputs. *(L2, stable)*
- [Process Noise](process-noise.qmd) — stochastic disturbance entering state evolution. *(L2, stable)*
- [Observation Noise](observation-noise.qmd) — stochastic measurement variability conditional on state. *(L2, stable)*
- [Identifiability](identifiability.qmd) — uniqueness of model specifications from observable distributions. *(L2, stable)*

## Temporal / kernel foundations

- [Kernel](kernel.qmd) — lag-dependent weighting in a temporal linear operator. *(L1, stable)*
- [Convolution](convolution.qmd) — lag-weighted combination of a signal and kernel. *(L2, stable)*
- [Deconvolution](deconvolution.qmd) — noise-sensitive inversion of a convolutional observation model. *(L2, stable)*

## Geometry foundations

- [Ambient Dimension](ambient-dimension.qmd) — dimension of the surrounding representation space. *(L1, stable)*
- [Intrinsic Dimension](intrinsic-dimension.qmd) — degrees of freedom under a declared model, scale, and criterion. *(L1, stable)*
- [Linear Subspace](linear-subspace.qmd) — a subset closed under linear combinations. *(L1, stable)*
- [Embedding](embedding.qmd) — an injective structure-preserving representation into another space. *(L1, stable)*
- [Manifold](manifold.qmd) — a locally Euclidean space with compatible smooth charts. *(L1, stable)*
- [Tangent Space](tangent-space.qmd) — the local vector space of first-order directions at a point. *(L2, stable)*
- [Metric](metric.qmd) — a point-to-point distance satisfying the metric axioms. *(L2, stable)*
- [Geodesic](geodesic.qmd) — a locally straight zero-acceleration curve under chosen geometry. *(L2, stable)*
- [Riemannian Metric](riemannian-metric.qmd) — a smooth field of tangent-space inner products. *(L2, stable)*
- [Curvature](curvature.qmd) — departure from flat geometry under a declared curvature notion. *(L2, stable)*
- [Topology](topology.qmd) — neighborhood and continuity structure defined by open sets. *(L1, stable)*
- [Circle / S¹](circle-s1.qmd) — one periodic coordinate with circular topology. *(L1, stable)*
- [Torus](torus.qmd) — the product of two circles or two periodic coordinates. *(L1, stable)*
- [Latent Trajectory](latent-trajectory.qmd) — a time-indexed latent random path, its posterior law, or a declared realization/summary. *(L2, stable)*
- [Dynamics on Manifolds](dynamics-on-manifolds.qmd) — tangent vector fields and flows constrained to a manifold. *(L2, stable)*
